subparts.final_answer: $Scatter plot of Mathematics scores vs Language scores$

mark_breakdown.desc: Correctly drawn scatter plot with points plotted accurately

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Scatter plots display pairs of numerical values to identify relationships between two quantitative variables.
step_by_step: Place Language ($x$) on the horizontal axis and Mathematics ($y$) on the vertical axis.
Mark the axes suitably (e.g., $x$ from 8 to 18, $y$ from 15 to 55).
Plot each of the 10 data points precisely.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Plotting repeated values only once instead of plotting all observations.

mark_breakdown.desc: Use of technology to find linear regression statistics
Correct value of Pearson's correlation coefficient rounded to 3 decimal places

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Pearson's correlation coefficient $r$ measures the strength and direction of a linear relationship between two variables.
step_by_step: Enter the data pairs into a statistical calculator or software.
Perform a linear regression analysis of form $y = ax + b$.
Read the value of $r = 0.8188878...$ and round to three decimal places.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Confusing the coefficient of determination $r^2$ with the correlation coefficient $r$.
